uniqueAbilities: No unique strengths; only weakness is Incense.

behavioralTells.incenseWeakness: Incense prevents hunts for 180 seconds (3 minutes) instead of the standard 90 seconds.

testingStrategies: Time the gap between using Incense and the next hunt. If it is consistently ~180 seconds, it is a Spirit.

uniqueAbilities: Never steps in salt and leaves no UV footprints.
Can teleport to a random player outside of a hunt, leaving an EMF Level 2 or 5 reading at the destination.

behavioralTells.saltImmunity: Salt is completely undisturbed when the ghost passes through it.
behavioralTells.teleportEMF: Unexplained EMF readings far from the ghost room.

testingStrategies: Place salt in chokepoints. If the ghost passes through during an event or hunt but the salt is untouched, it is a Wraith.

uniqueAbilities: Taking a photo of it makes it disappear temporarily.
Drains sanity at 0.5%/s when a player is within 10m during a manifestation or hunt.
Blinks slower during hunts, staying invisible for longer periods.

behavioralTells.photoDisappearance: A photo taken during an event shows a clear image with no ghost and no static.
behavioralTells.slowBlink: During a hunt, the ghost is invisible for noticeably longer intervals.

testingStrategies: Take a photo of a ghost event. If the ghost vanishes instantly but the audio continues, and the journal photo has no ghost or static, it is a Phantom.

uniqueAbilities: Can throw multiple objects at once in a 'Polty-bomb', draining 2% sanity per item thrown from all players in the room.
Throws an item every 0.5 seconds during a hunt (100% chance vs. normal 50%).

behavioralTells.multiThrow: A pile of items explodes outward simultaneously, often draining a large chunk of sanity.
behavioralTells.huntThrowing: Objects are thrown at a rapid, consistent rate during hunts.

testingStrategies: Pile several items on a table. If they explode outward all at once rather than one by one, it is a Poltergeist.

huntSanityThreshold.note: Based on the individual sanity of its target, not team average.

uniqueAbilities: Targets only one player at a time and ignores all others during hunts until the target dies or leaves.
Can only be female (check ghost name in van or manifested model).
Has a 33% chance to produce a unique scream through the Parabolic Microphone or Sound Recorder.
Higher chance to perform singing ghost events, draining 15% sanity if it touches its target.

behavioralTells.singleTarget: During a hunt, it walks directly past non-target players to reach its target.
behavioralTells.scream: A distinct, high-pitched wail on the Parabolic Mic.

testingStrategies: Have a non-target player stand directly in the ghost's path during a hunt. If the ghost ignores them and continues toward the target, it is a Banshee.

speed.condition: Fuse box is ON, has line-of-sight, and is more than 3m from the target.

uniqueAbilities: Cannot turn off the fuse box directly.
With the fuse box ON, can drain 25% sanity from a nearby player (within 3m or same room), leaving an EMF Level 2 or 5 reading at the fuse box.

behavioralTells.breakerLock: The fuse box is never turned off by the ghost.
behavioralTells.speedDrop: It moves very fast down a hallway but slows abruptly when within 3m of you.
behavioralTells.breakerEMF: An EMF reading at the fuse box with no visible interaction.

testingStrategies: Turn the breaker ON. If the ghost zooms toward you from a distance but abruptly slows when close, it is a Jinn.

huntSanityThreshold.condition: Lights are OFF in its current room (60%). If lights are ON, threshold is 40%.

uniqueAbilities: Cannot turn lights ON, only off.
Has a high chance to instantly turn off a light a player turns on within 4m of it.
Prefers to shatter lights during ghost events.

behavioralTells.lightOff: It will never turn a light switch on. If it does, rule out Mare.
behavioralTells.instantOff: A light you just turned on flicks off within one second.

testingStrategies: Turn on a light in its room. If it instantly turns it off, it is highly likely a Mare. If it ever turns a light ON, rule out Mare.

speed.condition: Moves at 1.0 m/s while roaming. Once it detects a player (LOS, sound, or electronics), it sprints at 3.0 m/s until it reaches the detection point.

uniqueAbilities: Extreme speed contrast between searching and chasing.

behavioralTells.slowRoam: Footsteps are painfully slow and dragging when it has not detected anyone.
behavioralTells.suddenSprint: The moment it detects a player, it breaks into a very fast sprint.

testingStrategies: Listen to footsteps. If they are extremely slow, then suddenly break into a sprint when it sees someone, it is a Revenant.

uniqueAbilities: Will not hunt if a player is in the same room.
Cannot perform successful interactions or ghost events in the same room as a player.
Cannot levitate objects.
Prefers 'mist' or shadowy ghost events over full physical manifestations.

behavioralTells.shyness: The ghost is completely silent and inactive while you are in its room, but active when you leave.

testingStrategies: Stand in the ghost room at 0% sanity. If it refuses to hunt until you step out into the hallway, it is a Shade.

huntSanityThreshold.note: Can use its ability to hunt at any sanity level.

uniqueAbilities: Can initiate a hunt at any sanity level via its ability.
Hunt cooldown is 20 seconds (instead of 25).
Incense prevents hunts for only 60 seconds (instead of 90).
Crucifix effectiveness range is increased by 50% per tier (4.5m / 6m / 7.5m).

behavioralTells.earlyHunt: A hunt at very high sanity (above 70%) is a strong Demon tell.
behavioralTells.fastCooldown: Hunts can occur in very quick succession.

testingStrategies: If you are hunted within the first 1–2 minutes at high sanity (above 70%), it is very likely a Demon.

uniqueAbilities: Can slam a door completely shut, draining 15% sanity from all players within 7.5m and creating an EMF Level 2 reading.
Is the only ghost that can move the front exit door outside of a hunt or event.
Using Incense on it forces it to stay in its room for 90 seconds.

behavioralTells.doorSlam: A door closes fully on its own, accompanied by a sanity drain.
behavioralTells.frontDoor: The main exit door clicks or moves without a hunt or event.

testingStrategies: If the main entrance door suddenly closes or clicks while you are exploring (not during a hunt or event), it is a Yurei.

uniqueAbilities: Very active when players are nearby.
Cannot perform the 'airball' (hissing mist) ghost event.
Drains double sanity (20%) if it collides with a player during a ghost event.
Blinks very rapidly during hunts, appearing in its full physical form more often.

behavioralTells.noAirball: If the ghost performs a transparent hissing mist event, rule out Oni.
behavioralTells.highVisibility: During a hunt, the ghost is almost always visible.

testingStrategies: If it does the transparent airball hissing event at you, you can instantly rule out Oni.

huntSanityThreshold.condition: Rises to 80% if a player is using voice chat in the same room.

uniqueAbilities: During a hunt, it is deaf and can only detect electronics or voice chat within 2.5m.

behavioralTells.deafness: During a hunt, you can move freely as long as you are silent and not within 2.5m.
behavioralTells.voiceTrigger: Talking near it can trigger an early hunt.

testingStrategies: Yell at it during a hunt from 4 meters away with your flashlight on. If it completely ignores you and wanders away, it is a Yokai.

speed.condition: Speed scales with room temperature. Below 0°C = 2.7 m/s; above 15°C = 1.4 m/s.

uniqueAbilities: Cannot turn on the fuse box and is more likely to turn it off.
During a hunt, if the fuse box is off, freezing breath is visible near its head.

behavioralTells.breath: Visible freezing breath during a hunt when the breaker is off.
behavioralTells.breakerOff: The fuse box is frequently turned off.

testingStrategies: Turn the breaker ON. If it sprints in its freezing room but slows to a crawl in a warm hallway, it is a Hantu.

uniqueAbilities: Its D.O.T.S. form is only visible through a video camera, and only when no players are in the same room.
Cannot change its favorite room and rarely roams far from it.

behavioralTells.cameraOnlyDOTS: D.O.T.S. evidence appears on the van's video feed but not to a player standing in the room.
behavioralTells.stationary: The ghost stays in or very near its favorite room.

testingStrategies: Set up a video camera and watch D.O.T.S. from the van. If you see it on camera but your friend in the room cannot see it, it is a Goryo.

uniqueAbilities: Footsteps and vocal sounds during a hunt are only audible within 12m (instead of the standard 20m).
Produces paranormal sounds more frequently on the Parabolic Microphone.

behavioralTells.quietHunt: A hunt sounds unusually silent until the ghost is very close.
behavioralTells.paramic: Frequent unexplained sounds on the Parabolic Mic.

testingStrategies: Hide with your flashlight on the floor. If the flashlight starts glitching BEFORE you can hear the ghost's footsteps, it is a Myling.

huntSanityThreshold.note: 60% normally, 40% when within 4m of a flame, and 100% after blowing out three flames with no other flames nearby.

uniqueAbilities: Lit flames act as crucifixes. If it tries to hunt near a flame, it blows it out instead.
Can hunt at any sanity level after blowing out three flames.

behavioralTells.candleCrucifix: A lit candle prevents a hunt by blowing out instead.
behavioralTells.blowoutHunt: After extinguishing three candles, a hunt begins regardless of sanity.

testingStrategies: Place a lit candle on top of a crucifix. If the crucifix burns before the candle blows out, rule out Onryo.

speed.note: Main twin is 10% slower (1.53 m/s); Decoy twin is 10% faster (1.87 m/s).

uniqueAbilities: Can perform interactions in two different locations at the exact same time.
A hunt can begin from the location of its last long-range interaction.

behavioralTells.doubleInteraction: Two EMF readings or interactions occur simultaneously in different rooms.
behavioralTells.kinkedActivity: The activity monitor line changes direction halfway up (a 'kinked' line).

testingStrategies: Look at the activity monitor in the truck. If you see a line that changes direction halfway up, it indicates The Twins.

huntSanityThreshold.condition: Rises to 65% when within range of active electronic equipment (6m small maps, 8m medium, 10m large).

speed.condition: Speeds up to 2.5 m/s when near active electronic equipment.

uniqueAbilities: Interferes with electronics from 15m away (instead of the standard 10m).

behavioralTells.electronicSpeed: The ghost zooms only while running past active electronics.
behavioralTells.glitchRange: Electronics glitch from unusually far away.

testingStrategies: Leave a line of active DOTS and EMFs in a hallway. If it zooms at lightning speed only while running past the equipment, it is a Raiju.

uniqueAbilities: Has a 16.6% chance to leave a six-fingered handprint or a two-finger lightswitch print.
Has a 25% chance to leave no UV evidence at all.
Fingerprints disappear twice as fast as normal.
Shapeshifts into a different ghost model for a split second while blinking at least once per hunt.

behavioralTells.sixFinger: A six-fingered handprint is a guaranteed tell.
behavioralTells.shapeshift: During a hunt, its model briefly changes to a different ghost.

testingStrategies: Watch it during a hunt. If it is a tall man but blinks into a crawling child for a microsecond and turns back, it is an Obake.

huntSanityThreshold.note: Copies the threshold of the ghost it is currently mimicking.

speed.note: Copies the speed and abilities of the ghost it is currently mimicking.

uniqueAbilities: Mimics any ghost, including their abilities, speed, and hunt thresholds.
Can change the ghost it is mimicking every 30–120 seconds.
Always produces Ghost Orbs as a fourth, fake piece of evidence, even on zero-evidence contracts.

behavioralTells.fakeOrb: Ghost Orbs appear on a contract where they are not one of the three evidence types.
behavioralTells.inconsistentBehavior: The ghost's speed and abilities seem to change mid-contract.

testingStrategies: If you find Ghost Orbs on a 0-evidence difficulty run, it is 100% a Mimic.

speed.condition: Speed increases as average sanity drops below the hunt threshold. Maximum speed is reached at 0% sanity.

uniqueAbilities: Can curse players through a successful Spirit Box response, Parabolic Microphone, or Sound Recorder. The curse doubles passive sanity drain and prevents light from slowing it. Sanity medication removes it.
Incense blinds it for 7 seconds instead of the standard 5.

behavioralTells.curse: Sanity continues to drain rapidly even in a lit room after a Spirit Box response.
behavioralTells.sanitySpeed: The ghost becomes noticeably faster as the team's sanity drops.

testingStrategies: Use the Spirit Box and get a response. Then stand in the light. If your sanity is still plummeting, you are cursed by a Moroi.

speed.condition: Moves at 3.0 m/s when far from its target and slows to as low as 0.4 m/s when within 6m.

uniqueAbilities: Has constant line-of-sight on all players during a hunt; hiding is impossible.
Has a 33% chance to produce unique heavy breathing through the Spirit Box when a player is within 1m.

behavioralTells.wallhacks: It always knows exactly where you are and walks directly to you.
behavioralTells.speedDrop: It sprints at you at extreme speed but slows to a crawl right before reaching you.
behavioralTells.heavyBreathing: Unique heavy breathing on the Spirit Box.

testingStrategies: Do NOT hide. Stand in an open room. If it sprints at you at mach speed but slows to a snail's pace right before hitting you, it is a Deogen. Loop it around a table.

huntSanityThreshold.note: Starts at 75% and decreases as the ghost ages. At Age 10+, it is 15%.

speed.note: Starts at 2.75 m/s and slows to 1.0 m/s as it ages.

uniqueAbilities: Ages over time when players are in the same room or within 3m. As it ages, it becomes slower, less active, and its hunt threshold drops.

behavioralTells.aging: The ghost is extremely aggressive and fast early on, then becomes progressively weaker and more passive.

testingStrategies: Ask the Ouija Board 'How old are you?' early on, then ask again 10 minutes later. If the age went up, it is a Thaye.

speed.condition: Slower base speed (1.53 m/s) but accelerates faster during line-of-sight, reaching max speed in ~8.67 seconds.

uniqueAbilities: Its hunt immediately ends if it detects and reaches a player hiding in an official hiding spot. However, on its next hunt, it moves directly to that spot and begins with no grace period.

behavioralTells.hidingSpotEnd: A hunt ends abruptly the moment it reaches your hiding spot.
behavioralTells.fastAcceleration: The ghost catches up to you in a straight line much faster than a normal ghost.

testingStrategies: Do not re-enter a hiding spot after it has found you there. If a hunt ended the moment it reached your hiding spot, it is an Aswang.

huntSanityThreshold.condition: 65% if a nearby player (within 10m) is moving, 45% if they are still, and 50% if no one is within 10m.

speed.condition: Speed is tied to nearby player movement within 10m. 2.25 m/s when a player is moving; 1.2 m/s when a player is still.

uniqueAbilities: Can only be female (name and model).
Its speed and hunt threshold are directly affected by the movement of players within a 10m radius, even through floors.

behavioralTells.movementSpeed: The ghost speeds up when you run and slows down when you stand still.
behavioralTells.stillnessSafe: Standing completely still makes the ghost much slower and less likely to hunt.

testingStrategies: When you suspect a Dayan, stand completely still during a hunt to slow it down. If the ghost is fast when you move and slow when you stop, it is a Dayan.

speed.condition: Starts at 3.0 m/s but decreases by 0.1 m/s for every unique object a player interacts with before a hunt. Minimum speed is 0.4 m/s (reached after 26 objects). Speed resets after each hunt or after burning a crucifix.

uniqueAbilities: Has a reduced chance to interact with doors and light switches (10% vs. standard 25%).

behavioralTells.speedChange: The ghost's hunt speed is noticeably slower if players have been interacting with many objects.
behavioralTells.doorRare: Doors and light switches are interacted with less often.

testingStrategies: If a hunt starts at extreme speed (3.0 m/s) but subsequent hunts are slower after you have intentionally interacted with many objects, it is a Deildegast.

uniqueAbilities: Cycles through three states: Normal, Enraged, and Weakened.
Becomes Enraged after burning a crucifix, being blinded by Incense, or stepping in salt. Becomes Weakened if a hunt ends while it is Enraged.
In its Enraged state, it does not leave footprints in salt.

behavioralTells.stateChange: The ghost's speed and aggression change noticeably after using protective equipment.
behavioralTells.saltNoPrint: Salt is disturbed but no UV footprint is left (Enraged state).

testingStrategies: Use Incense or a crucifix and observe if the ghost's speed and hunt threshold increase (Enraged). If it then becomes slower after a hunt ends, it is a Gallu.

huntSanityThreshold.condition: Rises to 70% if a nearby player is sprinting.

speed.condition: Base speed 1.7 m/s. Speeds up to 2.21 m/s when it detects a sound, and can reach a top speed of 3.65 m/s. Detection ranges: sprinting 30m, walking 15m, crouching 10m.

uniqueAbilities: Is completely blind and hunts purely based on sound.
Prioritizes the loudest sound (sprinting > walking > crouching).
Cannot perform mist or ghost chase events.

behavioralTells.blindness: You can walk or crouch-walk right past it without being detected if you are quiet.
behavioralTells.soundPriority: It always moves toward the loudest noise.

testingStrategies: Never sprint if you suspect a Kormos. If you can walk or crouch-walk directly past it without being detected, it is a Kormos.

huntSanityThreshold.note: Starts Calm. Becomes Aggressive one minute after the exit door is first opened, then alternates every two minutes.

speed.note: Calm state is slow but highly active. Aggressive state is fast, but hunts are 20% shorter.

uniqueAbilities: Cycles between Calm and Aggressive states on a timer.
Activity level is much higher in its Calm state and lower in its Aggressive state.

behavioralTells.stateCycle: The ghost's activity level and hunt speed change on a predictable timer.
behavioralTells.calmActivity: High interaction rate while the ghost is slow (Calm).

testingStrategies: Time the state changes from the moment the exit door is opened. A Calm Obambo is very safe (10% hunt threshold) but highly active. An Aggressive Obambo is fast but its hunts are shorter.
